steps: When something doesn't make sense, get some sleep first. One day, you'll understand.
What does it mean to "leave forever"?
A breeze drifts through. It's as if it has blown away all the earlier noise, leaving only the rustling of leaves behind.
I must answer her properly, but how should I phrase it...?
What do you think it means, Ann?
Hmm... I'm not really sure. Maybe they just went somewhere far away?
Answering with a question feels like shirking my responsibilities. After all, this is something one has to face as part of growing up.
I can't try to get out of it... I have to answer her question honestly!
I'm sorry, Ann, but the answer to that question runs a bit long...
Let's sit under that tree and talk about it.
Under the tree's thick branches, I stare in the direction the Bark Boar had wandered off to. After a moment of thought, I pick up a fallen leaf.
Ann, do you know where do these leaves come from?
Well...==W== First there's a seed, then a sapling, and when the sapling grows into a big tree, it falls from the tree...?
And where do the leaves go, in the end?
There will be lots and lots of leaves, piled up...==W== And then ... I don't know...
Every leaf has its own journey. Most will break down into the soil, helping new seeds sprout and grow into the next generation of great trees.
They turn into soil ... and help other trees grow?
Yes. Those who have left forever are like the fallen leaves. Does that make sense?
Once they lose their shape, fallen leaves might look like they're "gone," but they're still close by, sometimes even becoming part of a brand-new tree.
They are still close by ... as a part of a brand-new tree.
Yeah, it's not just true for trees and leaves. Animals ... and people are the same way.
Your forest friends "left" for all kinds of reasons and never came back... But in their own way, they're still with you.
That's right. Because you still remember all those friends who "left," don't you?
As long as you don't forget them, they'll always be with you, just like fallen leaves that turn into soil and stay with the trees.
"Leaving" just means they've changed form. You may not see your friends the way you used to, and that can feel lonely...
However, as long as you remember what they were like, you'll always feel their presence somehow... At least, that's what I believe.
"Leaving" just means they've changed form... But...==W== Um...
Uh oh, I might've used a hard metaphor. Was that a little too complicated for Ann...?
It's okay. Even if you don't completely understand it right now, you will, bit by bit, as you grow up.
Right now you're like a little sapling, still hasn't grown to your fullest. But one day, you'll for sure feel the presence of your friends around you.
Yeah! I'll eat lots of food and grow up so fast!
That's right, Ann. You have to eat properly or you won't grow.
Wow...! Oh my, bad Coco! You eat too much!
If you eat too much, you'll just grow into a ball instead of growing up!
Looks like it's been a long, tiring day. Let's head back to the village and get some sleep.
Well...==W== I think you might be tired too, Bossy! We should rest here first before going back to the village!
True that. Very thoughtful of you, Ann. Let's lie down and rest here for a bit.
What is it, Ann? Didn't you want to nap?
Haha. Sleeping while talking nonsense with eyes wide open—Ann really is something else.
Y-yeah! I can sleep with my eyes open, so sleeping like this is no problem at all!
No way! That kind of stuff only happens in fiction.
Ahem... Could it be that ... there's still something on your mind, Ann?
Actually, I'm a little scared... If I fall asleep one day, does that mean I'll leave everyone forever, too...?==W== When I think about that, I get too scared to sleep, so I just can't...
So that's what it was...? Hearing what I said earlier just made you even more worried, didn't it?
You don't need to worry. That kind of "leaving" isn't something that happens so easily. After all, you always wake up just fine, don't you?
Mm... But whenever I fall asleep, I always see the people and small animals who've already gone away.
You know, that's actually proof of the bonds formed by memories and feelings. It's not something to be afraid of.
I knew it. I didn't explain it properly in the first place. How about this...
Hey Ann, do you remember those dreams of yours?
Oh yes, yes.==W== There was this super cool candy house in the forest, and Coco grew wings and flew me around... We collected desserts and turned the village into a dessert kingdom!
But ... in my dreams, I saw people with ears just like mine whom I've never met before. And! There were also mean crow-people who bullied the village kids!
And then, together with Coco and Bubble, I used all the snacks we'd collected to defeat the crow-people and save everyone! That's the kind of dream I had!
I see. The reason you dream about people who have "left" is because they have got special tickets. Right now, they're living in the Kingdom of Dreams.
Really? There are special tickets like that? Can I get one, too?
Sure. But it's very very difficult to get.
If you want that ticket, you need to save up a lot of points every day.
Points...? But what if I can't get them every day...
It's okay if you can't here and there. The same is true for me, too. But it's a long term thing, so you have to work really hard to collect the points.
Every time you go to bed on time, rise up early, eat your veggies, stay active, and help others... You're earning those points.
I do all that stuff every single day!
That's right. You're doing great, Ann, so keep it up. Save up all those points, and one day, you'll make it to the Kingdom of Dreams.
If I put it this way, I know Ann will be able to face the problem with a positive mindset. Then the fairy tale I've created will actually mean something.
Hehe~ Coco and Bubble say that they've been saving up those points, too~
Looks like she's finally about to fall asleep. I guess I've reassured her a little.
I'm ... getting a teesy sleepy... I wanna lie down here for a bit ... ==W==Bossy... Will you stay with me...?
For as long as you want.
Ann curls up quietly beside me like a small animal, still looking a little uneasy.
Even though she can see the matter more positively now, the fear of being left behind still hasn't faded.
It seems like Ann is fighting off sleep because she's worried that I might leave her as well.
Just relax and take a nap.
I have a feeling ...==W== that you won't be here when I wake up...==W==
I'm sleepy==W== and wanna close my eyes,==W== but ...==W== I'm scared to fall asleep…
Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere.
Thank you,==W== Bossy...==W== Then, as long as you promise...
Ann==W== won't be scared...==W== I'm sure ==W==I'll fall asleep...==W==
So,==W== stay by me...==W== until I wake up...==W== Okay?
Yes,==W== promise me... ==W==Promise me you'll be here...
Ann ...==W== wants to be with Bossy ...==W== forever ...==W== and ever ...==W== and...
Looks like she's finally at ease.
Little by little, Ann relaxes and falls asleep, her tiny shoulders rising and falling softly with each breath.
Hmm, Ann's ears are twitching ever so slightly...
She must be exploring the Kingdom of Dreams right now. Hope her dream is a pleasant one.
Now then, I finally have a moment to start working on the plan for the Guild... Where should we go to get our next commission?
Eh?==W== Huh? She grabbed my hand. She's awake!?
Zzzz ... Coco! No eating my snacks...
Oh, she's talking in her sleep. But==W== she's this strong even while sleeping...? Wha—!?
Noooo, now Coco is here, too!
Hahah ... Now I really can't move a finger.
Looks like I literally cannot leave her. At least, not for a while.
And so, I stay by Ann and her friends' side until she wakes up.
